name: Shadow Strike (Combat)
body:
As a shadow’s energy infuses with your body, your strikes become harder to avoid.

Prerequisite: Wis 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, Shadow Style, base attack bonus +9 or monk level 9th, Knowledge (planes) 9 ranks.

Benefit: While using Shadow Style, your attacks move past your target’s armor. You may ignore up to your Wisdom modifier of either armor or shield bonus to your target’s armor class.
